error_definition: Incorrect prediction is the positive error event.
coverage_definition: For N evaluated samples, empirical coverage is k/N for every retained count k from 1 to N.
tie_handling: Within an exact score tie group, expected cumulative error is used so AURC is invariant to input row order.
aurc_definition: Mean empirical selective risk over all retained counts k=1..N, equivalent to a right-Riemann integral over coverage (0,1].
